name: perl-exception-class
description: This tool enables the declaration and management of a hierarchy of exception objects in Perl for structured error handling. Use when user asks to define custom exception classes, throw object-based errors with stack traces, or catch and inspect specific error types.
overview: `Exception::Class` allows Perl developers to move beyond simple string-based `die` calls by declaring a hierarchy of exception objects. This skill facilitates the creation of robust error-handling systems where exceptions are first-class objects containing error messages, time stamps, and full stack traces. It is particularly useful for large-scale Perl projects where different categories of errors (e.g., I/O, Validation, Auth) need to be caught and handled differently.
